editorial:
Ever felt like you talked yourself into a hole you just can't dig out of? That is exactly where you find Bradley Miller. He is just a regular high school kid who tries to impress the most popular girl, Stefanie, by promising her a legendary designer dress for prom. The problem is that he has zero dollars and her parents are scary bodybuilders who look like they could snap him in half. You will love the chaotic energy as Brad and his friend Angela come up with a wild plan involving a pawn shop, a prize-winning dog, and a fancy low rider car. It is a funny, stressful ride that feels like a classic teen comedy where everything that can go wrong actually does.

The movie moves really fast and keeps you guessing if Brad will actually survive the night. The chemistry between the leads is great, and the physical comedy with the bodybuilding parents is a highlight. While the plot is a bit over-the-top, it works because it never takes itself too seriously. If you are looking for something light and silly, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the end, Brad barely manages to get the dress and the dog back just in time. However, during the prom, he realizes that Stefanie is shallow and only cares about the clothes. He ends up ignoring her and spending the night with Angela, who actually supported him the whole time. The bodybuilding parents finally soften up, and Brad learns that being himself is better than pretending to be rich for a girl he doesn't even like.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy high school comedies and underdog stories.
